question: A group of 30 students has secured the average marks of 70 and another group of 20 students has secured the average marks of 80. What is the average marks secured by students of both the groups taken together?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of number of students = 30 : 20 = 3 : 2.

Let the base average be 70; deviation of the second group = 80 − 70 = +10.

Average increase = (Deviation × Parts) ÷ Total parts = (10 × 2) ÷ (3 + 2) = +4.

Combined average = 70 + 4 = 74.

**∴ The correct answer is 74 marks.**
